in_hebrew.name: כרלינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A feminine name derived from the Hebrew word 'kar' meaning 'grace' and 'el' meaning 'God'. The name Karlene can be interpreted as 'God's grace' or 'grace from God'.

in_greek.name: Καρλένη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Karlene has no direct Greek equivalent, but it can be derived from the Greek word 'kallos' meaning 'beauty' or 'purity'. In this context, Karlene can be interpreted as 'the beautiful one of God' or 'pure one from God'.

in_latin.name: Carlena
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Karlene in Latin can be derived from the name Charlotte, which means 'free man' or 'man of the sea'. Karlene can be interpreted as 'little free woman' or 'little sea woman'.
